manualChecklist: 【TC-16/S14 真麦克风那一半：Quinn 10-14 已把麦克风/扬声器口述放到一边，这一项暂不安排】
如果以后要做：每天约 5 分钟、连续 2–3 天（不是一次 5 分钟），本地栈、Mac 上的 Chrome（不是商店/TestFlight 版）。
第 1 天：开一个 QA 病人 → Encounter → Start bedside recording，说一句“QA16-DAY1 咳嗽好些了” → Stop；在 Encounter notes 里打一句 QA16-DAY1-TYPED。注意：main 上停止录音会自动开始 Generate Note & Finish。
第 2 天：同一病人再录一句 → Stop → 看 Prior Encounter Transcripts：第 1 天录音单独一行、日期是第 1 天；第 1 天手打的那句已不在输入框、出现在列表里。
第 3 天：只打开不录：记下第 1 天还在不在、第 2 天是不是作为“昨天”列出（Q1/Q12 未定，只记录）。
自动化那一半（桌面浏览器 + 语音桩 + page.clock，Generate 在 socket 处拦下）已经跑过，本清单只补“真麦克风/真设备”这一点。
TC-16/S14.productIssue: Ungated fail (TC-16 U7 has gate None), same root cause as TFA-94699 (Nursing Home last two visits; main SNF_RETENTION.transcriptVisits = 3). After visit 3 the Encounter tab lists V1, V2 and V3, and after visit 4 it lists V2, V3 and V4; the UAT expects the last two (UAT 3.6, TFA-92594 AC 2). Same result whether the visit text is written by snf:update or typed in the Encounter tab box (the app's autosave). The Hospital day-1 → day-2 cells pass. Recorded, not judged (Q1/Q12): on day 3 the day-1 recording is still listed ('<date> (prior)' entries from the bedside path carry no archivedAt, so the 48 h prune in convex/lib/lifecycle.ts never removes them) and day 2 is not listed as prior (it stays the working transcript until the next recording).
TC-16/S14.runNote: On main a stopped bedside recording (and a completed encounter dictation) starts Generate Note & Finish by itself (useGenerateAfterCapture). Earlier runs today let that Generate reach the model (forbidden locally); the specs now answer ai/notes:generateNote with a failure at the socket. In two local runs where the auto-Generate did run (15:58, 16:09 JST; the typed day-1 note was then written by rounding:update with the day-1 page still open), the typed day-1 note was gone from both the box and the prior list on day 2; with Generate withheld and the note typed in the box it is listed. Worth checking on dev, where Generate runs.
